lines.en: My tail ends in a club.
I move slowly along the treeline.

lines.zh: 背上的甲片一节节排着。
lines.en: The armor plates run in rows down my back.
I keep every step low to the ground.
I brush through a stand of pines.
My legs are short but strong.
The grass collapses where I pass.
I lower my head and crop some roots.

lines.zh: 锤尾扫过蕨叶，全压平了。
lines.en: My club sweeps the ferns flat.
The spikes on my armor knock the trunks.
I take the flatter path.

lines.zh: 我沿着针叶林边缘挪过去。
lines.en: I shift along the edge of the pine wood.

lines.zh: 我朝林子深处走了一段。
lines.en: I walk a stretch deeper into the wood.
I shift my body once more.
I settle beneath a pine.
The plates on my back overlap.
I rest my chin on the ground.
This patch of shade is very pleasant.
The wind doesn't reach my back.
My tail lies across beside me.
The smells in the wood are faint.
I can hear footsteps far off.

lines.zh: 松针落进甲缝里，有点痒。
lines.en: Pine needles tickle where they fell between my plates.
A few leaves have settled on my armor.
I'll just stay like this.
My weight settles the earth.
I don't even need to lift my head.
You're standing at my flank.
I turn my head slowly around.
This armor of mine is very hard.
Your hand is on the weapon's grip.
I bear no hostility at all.
A scatter of fallen leaves lies between us.
I'm quite a bit broader than you.
You snapped a twig stepping back.
My tail is still moving.
I wasn't thinking of fighting you.
I lower my head to my grass.
The blow turned me aside.
There's another mark on my armor.
I was shoved back half a pace.

lines.zh: 锤尾砸在地上，震了一下。
lines.en: My club tail hits the ground and the earth jumps.
My legs are still steady.

lines.zh: 甲片下那层皮被打青了。
lines.en: The hide under my plates is bruised.
The plates rang from the impact.
I don't much mind, really.
You hit quite hard, actually.
Is this grass for me?
I only eat this tender kind.
That small leaf in your hand is too little.
I shift over to sniff at it.
This one smells not bad.
Lower your hand a little more.
I don't need anyone to feed me.
There's grass growing all over.
I dip my head and raise it.
You've been holding that a long while.
You hit my armor and bounced off.
I didn't yield half a step.
The plates rang out loudly.
That didn't even make me sway.
My feet pressed out a pit.
You were bounced back two paces.
Our collision shook the tree.
My tail club grazed you.
That push means nothing to me.
I'm steady again.
This pine wood is roomy enough.
We needn't stand too close.
Your plates are thinner than mine.
Let's graze at the treeline together.
One sweep of my tail clears a patch.
Watching each other is enough.
We've come a long way together.
You're walking along my flank.
It's peaceful, walking like this.
Let's walk slowly back.
I nuzzle at it with my head.
This thing isn't grass.
I pressed it into the soil.
This one is beside my foot.
I push it along with my snout.
It's in the way of my mouth.
I bit it and spat it out.
It's heavier than I assumed.
I nudged it to one side.
You've stood by me too long.
I've raised my tail.
This club can break bone.
You've been forced to the treeline.
Trees won't check my steps.
I've fixed on your direction.
My armor covers me all over.
You're running up that slope.
That slope is very gentle, really.
I slowly lengthened my stride.
I'm only a few steps from you.
You can hear my plates.
I follow the prints you left.
You went around that boulder.
That rock isn't big to me.
I eat up this stretch step by step.
Your steps have gone panicked.
My tail rides across my flank.
You've turned your head twice.
I don't intend to stop at all.
This wood must end somewhere.
I'm a few steps behind you.
You're running for that clearing.
There's nothing to shelter behind there.
I lowered my head a little more.
I'm completely ready now.
My tail club comes down.

lines.zh: 你被撞得整个人翻过去。
lines.en: You were knocked right over.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整身的重量。
lines.en: That carried my full weight.
My head strikes your waist.

lines.zh: 你的护甲被撞出一个坑。
lines.en: Your armor has a dent now.
You've got behind a trunk.
That trunk has been knocked askew.
You couldn't keep your footing.
I held back some force there.
Sand sprayed up in a sheet.
I lift a foreleg and stamp.
Are you trying to get up again?
I stepped back half a pace to watch.

lines.zh: 我尾巴锤扫过，树都断了。
lines.en: My tail club sweeps through and snaps the trees.
Your breathing has grown heavy.
I stepped out from the tree shadows.
Pine needles landed on my back.
I raise my head gradually.
The grass here is fairly tender.
The soil here is loose and soft.

lines.zh: 我的尾锤轻轻摆了一下。
lines.en: My tail club sways once.
The treeline is a little warmer.
I hear someone approaching.
My tail club is harder than stone.
I lower my head and start grazing.
A sound came from the distance.
I look both tall and broad.
I've squared my body up.
The wood is very quiet today.
I begin patrolling this wood.
The heat warmed my armor through.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候地都陷了。
lines.en: The ground sank where I landed.
Water rushes into my nasal passages.
The shock slid me several blocks.
The arrowhead bounced off my plate.
That force came through my armor's seams.

lines.zh: 林边能嚼的草越来越稀。
lines.en: The grass here grows thinner and thinner.
Lightning struck my armor plates.
The ground just vanished.
